description: The creator thoulihan publishes a GLB representation of the Roland Water Tower in Baltimore through an Objaverse/Sketchfab mirror. Zenodo makes the mesh and preview images freely available under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies the historic structure and its street address, and gives original water-storage capacity and overall height as historical context. The asset can provide an identifiable water-infrastructure object for visual-scene and sensor-simulation preparation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tower. Coverage is a single decommissioned structure, with source publication dated August 2022, not a verified survey date. It is not documented as a hydraulic, structural or metrically calibrated engineering model. Reconstruction method, scale, georeferencing, materials and hidden geometry remain unknown. Historical dimensions must not be assumed to establish mesh accuracy. No geometry or preview images were downloaded or engineering performance inferred.
